description: Quote the connected account's exact Gold price for the plushie workflow: turn an owned image's subject into a plush toy illustration. Returns gold_cost, affordable and quote_token without starting a run, moderating, charging Gold or consuming a free sheet. After the user approves the price, call chargen_run_recipe_plushie with the same values and quote_token. For input rules, use chargen_get_recipe_plushie.

sourceImageId.description: Owned still image UUID from chargen_search_gallery

name: chargen_quote_recipe_plushie
title: Quote plushie
